input.expression: const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('ul a')].map(a=>a.href);const out=[];for(const h of links){const t=await (await fetch(h)).text();const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(t,'text/html');out.push(h+' :: '+d.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' '));}return out.join('\n');
